_about: Head track of Ostad's ExoMind cut (research/ostad/style/tools/face_track.py). MediaPipe Face Landmarker (478 landmarks, facial transformation matrix), One Euro smoothed. Coordinates: source pixels of the video, x right, y down. L/R = viewer's (image) left/right. Pose in degrees: yaw + = face turned toward image right, pitch + = chin up, roll + = clockwise on screen. headTop = foreheadTop + k * (foreheadTop - chin), k calibrated on the alpha matte.
